voice: Original energetic narrator: clear, expressive, conversational, fast but understandable. Not an imitation of any real person.

lines.text: This robot has 30 seconds to win ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND DOLLARS!
lines.delivery: Punchy hook, rising excitement, hit 'ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND DOLLARS' hard.

lines.text: All he has to do is survive the obstacle course!
lines.delivery: Quick, playful, slight dare in the voice. Finish before the countdown beeps at 5.15s.

lines.text: He dodged the hammers, jumped the platforms...
lines.delivery: Fast, rhythmic, riding the percussion. Trail off on 'platforms...' into the near-miss.

lines.text: But with seconds left... HE ALMOST LOST EVERYTHING!
lines.delivery: Drop to a tense near-whisper on 'But with seconds left...', then explode on 'HE ALMOST LOST EVERYTHING!'. Silence 18.4-18.9s.

lines.text: AND HE DID IT! ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND DOLLARS!
lines.delivery: Full celebration, big smile in the voice, shouted over the fanfare.

lines.text: But Bolt didn't keep a single dollar. He donated ALL of it to help others.
lines.delivery: Warm, sincere, slower. Small pause before 'He donated', land 'ALL of it' with heart.
